name: Power settlement reconciliation: congestion revenue, PMAs and counterparty disputes
description: The Portland real-time desk hand-calculates CAISO congestion relief revenue and emails it to the flash and settlement group to check against the next morning's flash. Volume Management recalculates it by hour. At month-end, desk heads and support review prior-month adjustments line by line and query mismatches with Settlements. They also reconcile ISO revenue against volume management and work counterparty disputes (El Paso Electric, SRP, MPC), which means requesting trade tapes and reconstructing what happened on specific hours.
stall_points: Amounts are hand-calculated, and hours go missing from both sides' calculations and from the CAISO site. One-sided PMAs, such as revenue reversed with no cost reversed, stay open across several emails. Disputes drag for months, and tape access goes through another person. About 30 disputes arose from EOL deals altered without notes. Sheets go to the wrong recipients.
automation: Compute hourly congestion revenue from CAISO award files and schedules, and reconcile it automatically against the flash, the inc sheet and settlement entries, alerting only on mismatches. PMA lines would be matched to Enpower deal changes so one-sided adjustments are flagged, and a dispute tracker would link each disputed deal to its tape, evidence and decision, with a required reason field on deal alterations.
